retraction.reason: Retracted in M21: elections to a Legislative Assembly held in Portuguese Angola between 19 and 27 March 1973, the first and the only ones. That is genuinely interesting — the late-colonial attempt at a settler assembly, a year before the regime fell — and the cached lead is one sentence long. Nothing in the atlas follows from it, and the war it was meant to answer is already here.

title: 1973 Angolan Legislative Assembly election
summary: Wikidata item Q18160604, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item carries no description in English or Portuguese.
